<!-- lemma-1: body_md -->
Let \(M\) be a neighborhood mask of degree \(4\), and let
	\(u:\mathbb Z^2\to\{0,1\}\) be a binary configuration. For any odd
	moduli \(k,\ell>4\),
	\[
	[L_Mu]_k\equiv[L_Mu]_\ell\pmod 2
	\]
	pointwise. Consequently, after one subsequent binary update,
	\[
	\bigl[L_M[L_Mu]_k\bigr]_2
	=
	\bigl[L_M[L_Mu]_\ell\bigr]_2 .
	\]
<!-- end lemma-1 -->
